description_en: Dune Bāhāḥ, one of the branches of Oku Bāhāḥ (LAL2260), is located in Okubāhāl Ṭola to the north of Oku Bāhāḥ. This Bāhāḥ can be accessed from two directions: either from the western side through a narrow alley between the houses opposite Mahābuddha Temple (LAL2340), or from the south through another alley passing through an open courtyard.The monument building can be found on the west side of the courtyard and faces east. The principal façade has a main central door that is decorated with carvings of  floral details and images of the Buddhist deities. The door is flanked by two narrow openings on either side. The ground floor of the building has been plastered in cement and painted white. It is separated from the first floor by a band of carved timber cornices. Apāsukājhyaḥwith three openings can be found at the centre of the first floor with two small arched windows on either sides. Above the central window, one can find a blind window with five arched recesses; these symbolise Pañcabuddhas. This floor was recently reconstructed using localdeśī apāon mud mortar (writing in 2019). The structure is covered with a sloped CGI sheet roof, and is surrounded by tall, five-storey buildings on three sides.The courtyard contains a central Buddha shrine with three tiers (3.7m high), a Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala (50 cm high) and a Dharmadhātu Jinālaya Caitya (1.7 m high).This Bāhāḥ was established by Punaju Śākya of Oku Bāhāḥ in NS 779 (1659 CE), which is why it is also called Pūrṇacandra Vihāra. Earlier, the god house of the monastic building had three storeys, however it was severely damaged by the 2015 earthquakes. As a result, the third floor has since been removed, and a roof of corrugated zinc sheets has been installed on top of the second floor. The façade of the first floor has atrikhājhyālawith a carvedtoraṇa;this is flanked by two small windows. Above the window, five niches made from terracotta symbolise the Five Buddhas. The ground floor houses the sanctum, which contains an icon of an east-facing Akṣobhya sitting in abhūsparśagesture. Dharmacakra Mañjuśrī sits to the left of the figure, whilst a statue of Avalokiteśvara can be found to its right. The entrance to the sanctum is flanked by two small windows but has notoraṇa. Instead, images of Akṣobhya Buddha, Prajñāpāramitā and Lokeśvara can be found above the door. A statue of a four-handed Ganeśa is housed in a niche to the right of the entrance (which lies to the south). Above this, there is atoraṇawith a further image of Gaṇeśa. Another niche to the left of the entrance (to the north) contains an image of Mahākāla; like the one on the right-hand side, this too is surmounted by atorana,this time displaying an image of Mahākāla.
description_ne: ओकुबहा:मा रहेको महाबुद्ध मन्दिरभित्र छिर्ने प्रवेशद्वारको अगाडि (पूर्व) तिर रहेको गल्लीबाट भित्र पसेपछि दुनेबहा:मा पुगिन्छ । ओकुबहा:का शाक्यवंशका पुनजुले नेसं ७७९ मा निर्माण गरेको विहार हुनाले यसलाई पूर्णचन्द्र विहार पनि भनिन्छ । यो ओकुबहा:को शाखाविहार हो । पहिले विहारको द्य:छेँ  तीन तल्लाको थियो । विसं २०७२ को भूकम्पले दोस्रो तल्ला चर्केकोले भत्काएर त्यसमाथि जस्तापाता राखिएको छ । द्य:छेँको पहिलो तल्लामा वज्रसत्व अंकित कलात्मक तोरणसहितको त्रिखाझ्याल राखिएको छ । यस झ्यालको माथि पञ्चबुद्धको प्रतीक स्वरूप टेराकोटाको पाँचवटा गवाक्ष राखिएको छ । त्रिखाझ्यालको दायाँ-बायाँ स-साना एक-एकवटा झ्याल राखिएको छ । भुइँतल्लामा विहारको क्वा:पा:द्य: स्थापना गरिएको छ । क्वा:पा:द्य:भित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकाको माथि कुनै तोरण राखिएको छैन, तर ढोकामाथि बुद्ध, धर्म र संघको प्रतीक स्वरूप अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध, दायाँ प्रज्ञापारमिता र बायाँ लोकेश्वरको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा साना झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । ती साना झ्यालहरूको दायाँ-बायाँ गणेश र महाकालको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । द्य:छेँको दायाँ (दक्षिणतर्फ) चारहात भएको गणेश स्थापना गरिएको छ । गणेशको माथि गणेश नै अंकित काठको तोरण राखिएको छ । त्यस्तै द्य:छेँको बायाँ (उत्तरतर्फ) कर्तृ र कपालपात्र धारण गरेका महाकाल स्थापना गरिएको छ । महाकालको माथि महाकाल नै अंकित काठको तोरण राखिएको छ । यस विहारमा क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा पूर्वाभिमुख गरी भूस्पर्श मुद्रामा बसेका अक्षोभ्य बुद्ध स्थापना गरिएको छ । अक्षोभ्य बुद्धको दायाँ (दक्षिणतर्फ) धर्मचक्रमञ्जुश्री र बायाँ (उत्तरतर्फ) अवलोकितेश्वर स्थापना गरिएको छ ।विहार परिसरमा टेराकोटाले बनाइएको बुद्धको मन्दिर, धर्मधातु मण्डल र धर्मधातु जिनालय चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ । यो विहार नेसं ७७९ मा ओकुबहालका पुन (पूर्ण) शाक्यवंशले निर्माण गरेका थिए ।

historical_events.event_description: The Vihāra was constructed by Pūrṇa Śākya, resident of Oku Bāhāḥ Lāchicāka, Dundugṛha.

historical_events.event_name: Donation of the statue of devotees
historical_events.event_description: Locke(1985,112) quotes the date as NS 851 butŚākya(1994,111) mentions NS 861. Since the stone inscription is damaged the date cannot be read anymore. Members of the monastery believe that the statue represents the donors who constructed the Buddha temple in the courtyard.

Cidhimāyā and her two sons Rājamāna and Ratna Bahādur consecrated the Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala. The Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala was originally in front of thekvāḥpāḥdyaḥbut was later moved between the Buddha Temple and the Dharmadhātu Jinālaya Caitya.
